steps.content:
5:00 a.m., January 24, N.F. 113
West bank of the Rust - My Best Cool Car parking spot

steps.speaker: Director" D
steps.content: Snore... Good night... Sweet dreams...

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Get up, it's morning! We said we'd go out early today. I'm gonna lift the blanket and put my cold hands on your back if you don't get up!

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Same with you, ${PlayerName}! Hold the camera steady! You're nodding off like a chicken pecking for food! Wake up, wake up!

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Ahem! Good morning, everyone!

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: As OwO had promised, the crew is all here, the equipment has all been updated, and the weather is wonderful. We're about to officially enter the second stage of our moviemaking journey... Going out to film!

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Huh? You can't see anything? Did our camera break?

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Haha, of course not! We just have a little surprise... Are you ready? Let's count down to three!

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: <size=40>Ta-dah! My Best Cool Car's transformation is complete!</size>

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: We've added all sorts of filming equipment, renovated the interior, and most importantly... customized the exterior!

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: We have to thank Love, Daisy and Lynn for working hard all night. My Best Cool Car is no longer its former self. Now it's... <color=#fb9259>My Best Cool Outdoor Filming Car</color>! So rad!

steps.speaker: Love
steps.content: Ahaha... Actually, we fell asleep halfway through last night. I don't know what happened...

steps.speaker: Daisy
steps.content: All the equipment looks expensive...

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: ...Did Mr. ${PlayerName} do it?

steps.speaker: Option
options: I also went to sleep early yesterday.

steps.content: You tell a little white lie.

The equipment was indeed sent from the MBCC and installed secretly overnight, but they were all "gifted" by an anonymous donor, mailed to the MBCC along with complicated instructions. All we know is it originated from Dillywood.
Was it that "Dean" wants to be nice? It really makes you have mixed feelings. The thought of going back to that place sooner or later to say thank you makes you feel itchy all over again.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: In any case, the script we've chosen is Star Lion Fantasy. It's not perfect, but we'll tweak it as we film. I won't give away any spoilers here!

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Director, Director! Are you going to introduce our filming plan?

steps.speaker: Director" D
steps.content: Snore... snore... Huh?! What??

steps.speaker: Director" D
steps.content: Ahaha... Well, to make better use of time and funds, we're going to adopt a more flexible approach.

steps.speaker: Director" D
steps.content: All the studios are gearing up for the DisCars Film Festival. We should take advantage of the chaos and get in there to film something.

steps.speaker: Director" D
steps.content: About the details... Ehh... I want the two leads, Stella and OwO, to improvise. Hehe... I just love it when the performance is natural.
This is obviously just an excuse to slack off. You already saw the neck pillow she prepared. She's probably ready to doze off at any moment.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: You can leave this important task to me!

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: There you have it, everyone! OwO is about to get serious! In the coming few days, the crew will get very, very busy, so it might be hard to update the vlog regularly.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: But we'll find other ways to share with you all our new inspirations and encounters along the way.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: The next time we meet, it might be through an unexpected update, or maybe we'd already be at the DisCars Awards Ceremony! Don't be shy and let your imagination run wild! OwO will definitely exceed your expectations!

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Now, it's time for My Best Cool Outdoor Filming Car to set off!

steps.speaker: Stella
steps.content: Squeak!!
